climb2.title: File:Man climbing in bouldering gym.jpg
climb2.author: John Kane
climb2.description: A photo of a man on working on a problem at the Bouldering Project indoor bouldering gym in Seattle. The photo is taken looking at one of the corners of the room. There is a man climbing a red route. The walls are teal. The pads on floor are black. The man has yellow shorts, a pink shirt and orange climbing shoes with black rubber soles. You can not see his face, it is blocked by his arm. The route he is climbing has many volumes making it fairly unusual for a gym route. You can see other routes of other colors: yellow, blue, green, purple and pink.
